There have been suggestions that guar gum reduces appetite by promoting a feeling of fullness, but a meta-analysis has indicated that it is not effective for reducing body-weight.7 Products con- taining guar gum have, however, been promoted as slimming aids. Their use cannot be advocated because of the risk of tablets swelling before reaching the stomach and causing oesophageal obstruction. 1. Hockaday TDR.
